description:
Bond Memory lets ChatGPT make choices grounded in your real preferences, past experiences, and the facts you have shared with Bond.

ChatGPT never receives a copy of your memory. It asks Bond a question and gets back a judgment with reasoning written for you. Three tools are available:

- Pick for you: give ChatGPT a few options (restaurants, products, movies, gifts, plans) and it picks the one you are most likely to prefer, and explains why.
- Worth telling you: before ChatGPT surfaces a deal, event, or find you did not ask about, it can check whether it clears your personal bar.
- Personalize a search: rewrites a search query around your tastes while keeping your intent and location intact, so the results ChatGPT searches for fit you.

Access is read-only. Nothing ChatGPT does through Bond Memory can change or delete anything in Bond.

To connect, you need the Bond iOS app installed and signed in. Approval happens on your phone: Bond shows a QR code in your browser, you scan it, and tap Approve in the app. No password is entered on the web.

You can disconnect every connected assistant at once from Settings in the Bond app.

Bond is a personal memory app for iOS. Learn more at bond.now/docs/mcp.

defaultPrompt: Which of these five restaurants would I like best for a Friday date night?
Is the jazz festival downtown next month worth my attention?
Recommend a pair of running shoes for me.
